summary: Completed frontend testing of bilingual FR/EN language switcher and Territory page refactored components. All features working correctly.

Language preference is persisted in localStorage and respects browser language on first visit
Navigation labels, hero section, cart button all translate correctly when language is switched

Territory filter shows appropriate hint text based on selected territory type (ZEC: 086, 027, 037 | Sépaq: 13, 08, 04)

Territory analysis shows 'not found' toast when territory doesn't exist in database - this is expected behavior.
